items.title: 68359_Zutty Singleton oral history interview
items.q: He tells about Punch Miller in that tape.

ctx.x: Well that's something else. He tells about Punch Miller in that tape. (LAUGHTER). He let Punch Miller right on that tape. He made it himself. Lucille doesn't have that tape. Nobody has that tape. It was made in the Alvin Hotel on Louis' last go round. He and Zutty were talking about old times.
Yes. And we were talking about pictures on the wall. He said, now who is this cat? Who is this? And I would explain it to him.
